The '''Z-TIE''' was a variety of [[Ugly/Legends|ugly]] hybrid [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that was created by affixing the chassis of a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] to the hexagonal [[Solar collector/Legends|solar panel]] wings of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a Z-TIE was utilized by a band of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] led by the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Bandin Dobah]] to defend their [[Bandin Dobah's asteroid base|asteroid hideout]].
